forbidden: a modern animal in a prehistoric scene
mosasaurus.look: A massive, streamlined marine reptile with a long, muscular body covered in small, smooth grey-green scales. It has four robust, paddle-like limbs positioned mid-body and a long, powerful tail ending in a distinct, downward-bent hypocercal fin. The head is large and robust with a wide mouth full of large, sharp, conical teeth, and the eyes are positioned high on the skull.
